population.note: A deterministic every-Nth sample of open engine-a-recall findings, each replayed live. Percentages are of the SAMPLE.

stages.label: no longer reproduces
stages.note: Fixed since the finding was filed — these should clear on the next detector run, and their presence in the open count is staleness, not debt.

stages.label: returned, but below top-3
stages.note: The row IS retrieved for the query and simply ranks too low. The cheapest class to fix, and the one scoring changes actually move.

stages.label: not returned for the query at all
stages.note: The tier ladder never admitted the row for this phrasing, though its exact name resolves. Vocabulary, anchors, and synonym work live here.

stages.label: own exact name does not return it
stages.note: The record exists but cannot be found by its own identifier — the slug-in-haystack and split-identity class.

stages.label: not in the directory at all
stages.note: No retrieval change can answer this. It is a coverage job: the entity must be added before any query can find it.
